Preface
This book evolved from my notes for a three-semester sequence of core courses
on theoretical statistics for doctoral students at the University of Michigan.
When I first started teaching these courses, I used Theory of Point Estimation
and Testing Statistical Hypotheses by Lehmann as texts, classic books that
have certainly influenced my writings.
